scripts.test: bash -lc 'NODE_BIN=${NODE_BIN:-$(command -v node)}; if [ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/node ]; then NODE_BIN=/opt/homebrew/bin/node; fi; exec "$NODE_BIN" ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs'
scripts.test:coverage: bash -lc 'NODE_BIN=${NODE_BIN:-$(command -v node)}; if [ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/node ]; then NODE_BIN=/opt/homebrew/bin/node; fi; exec "$NODE_BIN" ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --coverage'
